facts.label: Switches
facts.text: Kailh Choc V1 (PG1350) in hot-swap sockets (CPG135001S30); hot-swap only, like the Keyball

facts.label: Key pitch
facts.text: 18 x 17 mm, Keyball39 column stagger and thumb arc

facts.label: Trackball
facts.text: 19.05 mm POM ball on the right half, PMW3610 sensor at 600 CPI on a daughterboard

facts.label: Controller
facts.text: nRF52840 Pro Micro form factor (nice!nano v2 or SuperMini), BLE split, ZMK

facts.label: Firmware
facts.text: ZMK, pinned to 4dd95d7; keys, pointer, ZMK Studio

facts.label: Battery
facts.text: LP552035 LiPo, 350 mAh, one per half in a bay under the PCB

facts.label: PCB per half
facts.text: 121.0 x 86.7 mm, two different boards (left, right) and a sensor board

facts.label: Case height
facts.text: 22.8 mm from the tray bottom to the controller cap

facts.label: Parts cost
facts.text: about 240 EUR for one keyboard, PCBs in batches of five included
